143.news_title: Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 ready for purchase
143.long_description:
Our Game Wizard Xtreme 3.0 is the most advanced joystick arcade machine we’ve created yet! Built by industry professionals, our Xtreme 3.0 is an effective step forward in both home gaming setups and commercial arcades. With 1ms HD gaming monitor, Sanwa joystick and buttons and over 800 unique custom combinations, the Xtreme 3.0 is the most dynamic machine in the market! 

With the latest Xtreme 3.0 machine, play virtually any arcade JAMMA game board, or current series JVS arcade game boards. Furthermore, adding on the Game Wizard bundle to your order allows you to plug and play almost any current series consoles such as Xbox Series S & X. PlayStation 5, PC, Nintendo Switch, and many more! The Xtreme 3.0’s versatility shines through the ability to continually receive free firmware updates as well as adding various add-ons that are easy to change yourself. 

Create an authentic and long-lasting arcade experience personalized to you through our product builder, allowing you to customize button layouts, color schemes, hardware and more!
